classification.difficultyReason: Represent both equal sides with one unknown and solve the resulting area equation.

content.prompt: The area of this isosceles triangle is $35\text{ cm}^2$. Find the length of the equal sides to 2 d.p.

spec.description: Upright black isosceles triangle with horizontal base. One matching black equality tick on each sloping side. The apex has an internal 35° label without a visible arc. No side labels or vertex letters.
spec.mathematics: Equal sloping sides enclose 35°; area 35 cm² is given in the stem.

answer.worked:
Let each equal side be $x\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}
35&=\frac12x^2\sin35^\circ\\[8pt]
x^2&=\frac{70}{\sin35^\circ}\\[8pt]
x&=\sqrt{\frac{70}{\sin35^\circ}}\\[8pt]
x&\approx11.05\text{ cm}
\end{align*}$$
